story: Hades9mm drafted every one of his 23 picks himself, and the roster shows it: Jayden Daniels and Jared Goff at quarterback, Amon-Ra St. Brown and London at receiver, Derrick Henry and Cam Skattebo at running back, Kittle and Kelce at tight end. Week 6 was an 89.08 to 83.34 win over Snipe58, the lowest-scoring game of the week, with Jayden Daniels at 21.0 and 16.4 left on the bench. He is 4-2, 3rd in the standings, with 832.5 points, third in the league. FAAB is $330, and he has not been spending it.

The files feud with Darkspaces is still his best content: four 1sts for Mendoza, Maye, Achane and Egbuka, followed by a threat to release the trade-talk logs.
